statistics_policy.visibility: alpha >16; color statistics use only visible sampled pixels
statistics_policy.linear_luminance: sRGB IEC inverse transfer, Rec.709 weights .2126 .7152 .0722
statistics_policy.warning: Metrics indicate candidates for visual review, not proof of lost detail or overexposure

revision_policy.known_processing_versions: Skip a live SHA matching original_sha256 or output_sha256 for the SAME PATH in current processing records; refresh processing knowledge if that file changes.
revision_policy.previous_capture: Reuse only the same path's same captured SHA; retain existing supplementary rows as report evidence without measuring them again.
revision_policy.latest_sha: Latest captured original SHA, which may differ from live_sha256 after an already-known exposure output is published.
revision_policy.new_revision: Capture only a SHA different from the same path's known processing versions, audit SHA and previous captured SHA.
revision_policy.history: Prior captured original revisions remain in per-asset source_history and immutable backup files. processing.json is never written.

package_boundaries.qdao_character_diversity_v9: 01-22 delivered portraits overwrite q_daoist_character_pack_4096; .work raw/reference/process files are excluded. The v9 manifest is an index, not another portrait output set.
package_boundaries.unity_slices: 31 png/ exports are runtime sprites; sources/ are final artwork snapshots retained in source coverage. sprite-overview and unity-sprite-preview are presentation/validation views, not runtime textures; included by the original audit classification.
package_boundaries.v8: Entire exposure-refinement package excluded from input scan, including previous processed outputs, snapshots and review images.
